commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/bloomml-m03.Iyqgfp/source
BASE=2e816ce6a8b57d47e98028b3f27d6f359c40025e
CODE=4fc585d3155bddb115d3c5e6a52123f791edaf8c
PUBLISH=f091bdd1356fe73b53b003ad77069f612811e9b6
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$PUBLISH"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "$CODE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test "$(git diff --binary "$BASE" "$CODE" | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')" = 1c0ea4b9f9c3c1adec9fe2768532bc7159934aacf494c3c945b25f5392882b40
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$BASE" "$PUBLISH"
git fsck --connectivity-only --no-reflogs --no-dangling
echo "NEW_OBJECTS|$(git rev-list --objects "$BASE"..HEAD | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
git rev-list --objects "$BASE"..HEAD | git cat-file --batch-check='%(objecttype) %(objectsize) %(rest)' | sort -k2,2nr | head -n 8
# Ordinary fast-forward with a non-thin pack to rule out missing delta bases.
# No force, no alternate credentials, no changed permissions. Packet trace
# is kept in a private temporary file; publish only allowlisted status fields.
TRACE="$(mktemp /tmp/bloomml-m03-packet.XXXXXX)"
chmod 600 "$TRACE"
set +e
GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_TRACE_PACKET="$TRACE" git push --no-thin --porcelain origin HEAD:main
rc=$?
set -e
echo "PUSH_RC|$rc"
python3 - "$TRACE" <<'PY'
import re,sys
from pathlib import Path
text=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(errors='replace')
for line in text.splitlines():
    match=re.search(r'\b(?:unpack (?:ok|error|failed)|(?:ok|ng) refs/heads/main(?: [A-Za-z0-9_. -]{1,100})?)\b',line)
    if match: print('PACKET_STATUS|'+match.group(0))
print('PACKET_TRACE_LINES|'+str(len(text.splitlines())))
PY
REMOTE="$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "REMOTE_MAIN|$REMOTE"
if [ "$REMOTE" = "$PUBLISH" ] && [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "M03_PUBLISHED_SHA|$PUBLISH"
  echo M03_CLOSED_SCOPED
else
  test "$REMOTE" = "$BASE"
  echo M03_BLOCKED_REMOTE_REJECT
  exit 1
fi
